steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Hm, right on time.

The Liberi steps out onto the rooftop of a tall tower and looks up at the sky. From this high vantage point, the faint, sharp screech is concealed by the sound of the wind, while the faint spot of light rapidly expands in her eyes.
Her thick tail dexterously and rhythmically sweeps back and forth. A graceful measure to which the Liberi can compare the invisible grid of the city beneath her.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Now, let's see... Just where will this 'star' land in Trimounts?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Districts 2 and 5 are primarily residential. 11's new industrial campus is under construction...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Let's hope it won't be Central. That place is packed with office buildings like the dime a dozen canned fins you get at the supermarket. And it's a work day. Those offices are gonna be full of people... Hmph.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Well, you really figured out where to land this experiment of yours...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Or maybe you just never cared how much of a racket this might cause?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Either way, you planned this far ahead. Things are getting more and more interesting... Kristen.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Confirmed—the Triton factory in District 13.
The Liberi leaps from the tall tower.

options: Ufff... Who pulled the curtains open?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's a big yawn. Didn't sleep well?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Do you usually stare at the ceiling for a while after you wake up?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Look at the time. The Rhiners have been at work for an hour already.

options: Trimounts hotels really care about guest privacy, huh?
Is this how a Rhine Lab director welcomes a guest?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I wanted to see you; that's why I'm here.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You saved me from the power armor, and I brought you breakfast. Fair's fair, right?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's the breakfast combo from the cafe at Rhine Lab HQ. They only sell a hundred of those a day.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Okay, okay, don't give me that look. You're a Grumpy Gus in the morning, huh?

options: It's Saria you want to see, right?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Well, I haven't been able to contact her, but if she isn't here, then coming to you won't help.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Anyway, take a look at this.

steps.name: News
steps.text: This just in, Trimountians. An explosion occurred this morning at the Triton Chemical Plant No. 3 in District 13.

steps.name: News
steps.text: The specific cause of the explosion is still unknown, but the authorities' preliminary conclusion is that laboratory staff made a fatal error leading to the construction machinery on site exploding.

steps.name: News
steps.text: A large stockpile of catalysts and reagents are stored at Triton Chemical Plant No. 3 , and to keep the chemicals from leaking out and causing more catastrophic damage, the military and government authorities are currently cleaning up the site.

steps.name: News
steps.text: As of right now, all of District 13 is under temporary lockdown. Entry and exit from the district is being heavily restricted. Citizens are asked to cooperate with the ongoing work there.

steps.name: News
steps.text: The government has not responded to request for comment, and it is not known at this time whether the lockdown in District 13 will affect Vice President Jackson's time in Trimounts.

options: Does this have to do with Rhine Lab, too?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I don't know the specifics.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But if you, or should I say Rhodes Island, are here, considering how much Saria trusts you, there's no way you would ignore big news like this.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Okay, Doctor, you've got some new visitors... I'll see you very soon.

options: So that was a clone after all.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Rise and shine, Dr. {@nickname}, ya big dumbass! Rise and shine!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Long time no see, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ptilopsis has already returned to the landship with Elena for checkup and treatment. Mechanist is currently on a new mission. From here on, I will be accompanying you.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: And me! And also...
The floaty Feline girl apparently entered the room at some point. She stands next to the window and listens quietly to your conversation.
She gazes at you and your room. Behind her, there are pure white clouds floating gently across the clear Trimountian sky.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Don't be mad, Doctor.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I asked Dr. Kal'tsit to bring me along. I was... invited by someone.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will explain more about what's going on later... Seeing as you have the TV on, it seems you already know about District 13.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The explosion wasn't caused by some careless lab technician. Something fell from the sky.

options: We need to get to the bottom of this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes. Saria has already gone to investigate.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As for you, I need you to get out of bed and wash up.

steps.name: Angry Citizen
steps.text: I live there. Who the hell are you to stop me from going home?

steps.name: Angry Citizen
steps.text: What gives you the right to lock the place down, anyway? Is this even legal? Do you have anything in writing? I'm supposed to take your word that this is an emergency?

steps.name: Anxious Citizen
steps.text: I'll be out in ten minutes!

steps.name: Anxious Citizen
steps.text: I just need to head back for some documents. Our clients are waiting in the conference room!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Sorry, but I need to see your clearance.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Interesting. I was going to watch Saria, to see what she's up to. I never expected to find this little bird making her way here.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Right... That's the little researcher from the 'Diαbolic Crisis.'

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Scouting the area with a drone from a dead angle while hiding in the crowd, waiting for an opportunity. Not bad.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: But the army has soldiers watching every single alley. It won't be so easy for you to break through their checkpoints.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: That said...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I haven't the slightest idea what you can do, but you might just be able to give these baddies a little trouble, so I'll give you a hand.
What are you blabbing about?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Nothing. The package's recovered. It'll be delivered right away.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: As you've no doubt heard on the news...

steps.name: Angry Citizen
steps.text: It's just one factory that had an accident. Why is the entire district on lockdown?!

steps.name: Angry Citizen
steps.text: If you guys are actually worried about the chemicals, why aren't you wearing protective equipment? Why are you people still allowed to come and go? No one is buying your beastshit!

steps.name: Anxious Citizen
steps.text: This is about the whole industrial campus upgrade project! If it falls through, who's gonna pay?

steps.name: Anxious Citizen
steps.text: Hurry up and let me by!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: No pushing!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: My arm. Why can't I move...?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Somebody broke through the cordon... How come the comms aren't working, either?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Your clearance, Miss Saria?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You know me?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Former Defense Director of Rhine Lab. Your reputation precedes you here in Trimounts.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: So I can't enter District 13?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Not just you.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: If you don't have clearance, please leave.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: You—!

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Relax. Stow your weapon.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Your face... Your hands... you...

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: It's the same all over. I may look scary, but it's just an exoskeleton.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: I work for the Maylander Historical Association, currently part of the vice president's entourage as his secretary. Here's my authorization.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Miss Saria here is the subject-matter expert we invited along.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Maylander, huh? You people are always so strange.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Go talk to your superiors. We want to get a better grasp of the situation.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Give me a minute.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Looking at your attire... It seems you don't plan on bringing your shield along?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: No, I just determined that I might need to apply full force to whatever is coming next.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Full force, huh...? That phrase carries a weight far heavier than usual coming from the former director of the Rhine Lab Defense Section.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Seems like I did make it in time.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Our last meeting must have been at Haydn Pharmaceuticals, Detective.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: We talked so much that I forgot to slide you and Muelsyse a free pint of draft beer on your last visit.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I know just how powerful the Maylander Foundation is, but I was still surprised when I heard the news from Kal'tsit... how do the two of you know each other?

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: We're just old friends.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: So, what role is the Maylander Foundation playing in our current situation?

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Saria, are you interested in politics?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Decidedly not.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: So do I really need to answer that question?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: The Colonel is en-route to his meeting with the Vice President. Your identities have been verified, and the Colonel has authorized your entry to District 13.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: But we're conducting an emergency investigation to evaluate the hazard posed by the chemical leaks, so you won't be allowed near Triton Chemical Plant No. 3. That's where this all went down.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: We'll also arrange an escort party to go with you, to provide any necessary help.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: No problem. We will go with your arrangements.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Phew—made it in.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Next, I keep two drones up in the air a hundred meters apart to survey the situation.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The Triton factory should be right up ahead. I hope the stealth combat tactics I learned at Rhodes Island will come in handy here, let's take it slow...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Will I really find any leads on the Transmitter here?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: A batch of Transmitter has gone missing?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: That's right. To be more precise, it was a batch of experimental materials with said Transmitter included that was supposed to be shipped together to HQ. For disposal.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: So someone stole it.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: And it's very likely to be someone within Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Silence, I'd like you to head to Trimounts and help me investigate this.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I need to remain at Site 359 to cooperate with the military investigation, so I'll be stuck here for the time being.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Are you going to negotiate with them?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Don't worry, as much as I don't enjoy this stuff, I'm still capable of it. I'm a Rhine Lab director, after all.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'm more worried about this batch of missing Transmitter becoming the catalyst of someone else's ambitions.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: So, can you do it?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Silence, you're a student of Director Parvis, and yet you showed up here at Site 359.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I had some doubts, but now I get it: You came here to ask for my help.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Or maybe you wanted to know if the Director of Originium Art is trustworthy.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...I'm sorry.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: No need for apologies. I did come close to doing something awful. I should be thanking you, Silence.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: But at the same time, this is why I'm asking for your help. You are beholden only to your own standards, and looking for your own answers.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Even if I hadn't asked you, you still would've returned to Trimounts, right?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Oh no. Why are there suddenly a lot more men on patrol?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier A
steps.text: Shit. Find anything over there?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier B
steps.text: I searched a couple alleyways over on the side. Nothing.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier A
steps.text: The Colonel is about to meet the Vice President, so we had to play nice and let those two in. We were supposed to stick close to them. How did they lose us so quickly?!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier B
steps.text: They were walking so leisurely the whole time, then they vanished behind a fence when I blinked.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier A
steps.text: We really underestimated that fella all covered in iron. Maylander's people are always so tricky.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier B
steps.text: I'll go report the situation to the brass. Take the boys with you and continue the search.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier B
steps.text: Right, send more hands over to the factory too.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Your reflexes and stealth skills are admirable, Mr. Detective

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: You flatter me. Even if we could manage them, it's better to shake them off our tail than to outright knock these sycophants out.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: We're here. Triton Chemical Plant No. 3 is right up front.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: They've already cordoned off the perimeter, and deployed heavily armed soldiers at every possible location. Quite the impossible task to get any closer.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: We're close enough for a clear view.
Saria's gaze travels over the throng of people and past the striking yellow barriers, landing on the factory behind.

The once-smooth factory building has been demolished beyond recognition, with scorch marks scrawled by heaps of debris scattered all over. A series of explosions have eroded the facade, leaving only the interior foundations that give her a clear view—
In the center of the factory lies a huge ring-like mechanical structure, diagonally embedded into the ground like an outrageous art installation.
The source of the explosion.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: What have you found?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Neither the shape nor the mechanical structure of the object hints at its purpose, but it is clearly a device not meant to be used on land.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: It fell from the sky.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: We're too far away to discern any concrete details. But what can be confirmed at the very least is... this thing has the mark of Rhine technology.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: To be precise, it has Kristen's handwriting all over it... I'm sure of that.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: 'Horizon Arc Project'.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: I'm surprised you've not heard the name, given your position at Rhine and your relationship with Kristen.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm glad I didn't get spotted...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: There really was one here!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It's gone...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Dorothy was right. Transmitters react to each other, and it wasn't too difficult to catch them with the one she gave me.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But there's too few of them, Dorothy said there were more... could they be nearby?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Wait...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This is... the Triton Factory?
A colossal ruin lies before her.
Just how many injuries or casualties happened in there? Silence recalls the news not mentioning any numbers relevant to that question.
She recalls the destruction at Site 359, it was difficult for her to even picture what it looked like before the ruins.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Was that Saria? Who was that with her...?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Saria, do you have something to do with this, too?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Do you know where we're going?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're heading to Saria's stronghold in Trimounts as part of our arrangement with her.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Saria! It's been ages since I saw her.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: But if you need to talk to Saria, you two are gonna be busy, right? I guess she won't have time to talk to me?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You and Rosmontis will stay with the Doctor.

options: Ifrit, where were you just now?
Ifrit, tell me more about what you did on the way here.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Oh, right... When the star came falling down, I was telling Rosmontis a story that Silence told me before.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: You still remember it, right? You weren't writing any of it down...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Yep, I still remember.

a.text: That night, it seemed the entire city heard the queen's prayers and the sound of her tears splotching onto the sand... In the end, the queen passed out in the high tower of the palace.
The queen's faithfulness reached the hearts of the stars. One after another, they soared through the skies and came before the old king.
The old king was swallowed by the endless surge of brightness. Within it, he saw a sight that he had never seen nor dreamed in his entire life.

The next morning, the queen awoke to find a huge hole had appeared on the palace's roof, and the old king, who had passed away hours ago... stood with a smile still lingering on his now stiffened lips.
Were the stars brought here by her prayers?
The stars made her wish come true, and they took her lover with them.
